verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs cover all three pillars on one platform. Spend is handled through corporate and virtual cards with auto-receipts, bill pay through PO-matched invoices with end-to-end payment, and banking through a Checking Account with free same-day ACH and wires plus an Investment Account. A customer case study says it replaced 4 separate tools with Ramp's all-in-one platform, and a community user confirms the card and expense flow works well. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that founders actually consolidated bill pay and banking onto Ramp (the case studies are vendor-published), and banking availability beyond the US (banking is US-only).
